title: Finite stabilized construction for supported perfect maps
statement: Let X be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], U a quasi-compact open, and T a closed subset with quasi-compact complement. Let E belong to D_QCoh(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. Let S_n be a sequence in D(O_U), with isomorphisms h_n: S_(n+1) ≅ S_n ⊕ S_n[1]. Assume S_0 is perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex] and supported on T intersect U. Let a_n: S_n → E|U satisfy a_(n+1) = a_n composed with the first projection composed with h_n. Then there exist n, a perfect R on X supported on T, beta: R → E, and e: R|U ≅ S_n such that beta|U = a_n composed with e. No retraction is part of this conclusion.

proof.text: Define P(W) to say there exist n, an ambient R and beta to E, local perfectness at every point of W, cohomology-stalk support on W intersect T, and e:R|U isomorphic to S(n) with beta|U=e.hom followed by a(n). The initial ambient extension lemma applied to S(0) and a(0) proves P(U).

Given P(W) for a quasi-compact W containing U and an affine V, apply the affine attachment lemma to its R and beta. Compose its restriction isomorphism with the biproduct of e and its shift and then (hS n).symm. The equation ha n, cancellation of (hS n).inv followed by (hS n).hom, and biprod.map_fst give the required equation for a(n+1). Thus P(W union V).

Cover X by affine opens using Mathlib exists_isAffineOpen_mem_and_subset and choose a finite subcover by IsCompact.elim_finite_subcover. Induct on its Finset, starting with U. Compactness is preserved at each step by IsCompact.union, since affine opens are compact. The preceding attachment step proves P of each finite union. The covering equation makes the last union top. At top the local perfectness is exactly IsPerfect X R and the pointwise support implication is global, yielding the unchanged conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09IM, finite affine-cover induction; the formal ambient invariant uses the extension-by-zero adjunction of Tag 08BT
